messages.subject: secr 4.4.7
parts:
secr 4.4.7 is now on CRAN. Most changes are minor or not visible to users, but
o   addCovariates() now accepts RasterLayer spatialdata
o   make.capthist() and read.capthist() tweaked to allow nonspatial input
o   sim.popn() has some new movement kernels
o   a bug in snip() has been fixed
o   relations with package 'spsurvey' have been suspended, perhaps temporarily. The packages clashed during submission to CRAN and I have yet to get my head around the much-changed spsurvey 5.0.0. This means the 'GRTS' option of trap.builder() does not work in 4.4.7.
